import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read and aggregate patient counts by department
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/clinic_ja.csv')
totals = df.groupby('診療科')['患者数'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
# Linear scale and zero baseline keep the comparison honest; annotate totals for clarity.
bars = ax.bar(totals.index, totals.values, color=['#2878B5' if dept == '内科' else '#A9B8C6' for dept in totals.index])
ax.set_ylim(0, max(totals.values) * 1.12)
ax.set_title('診療科ごとの患者数合計（2026年1〜3月）')
ax.set_xlabel('診療科')
ax.set_ylabel('患者数（人）')
ax.bar_label(bars, padding=3)
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.25)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
